scope: Source-bound natural SP Precise batch ticks and independent request/rate declarations; not actual SP/timer/skill acceptance

facts.floor_to_int: FP.Floor masks low32; FP.AsInt arithmetic-shifts32 then returns eax signed32; no float conversion
facts.unary_min64: returns FP.MaxValue raw9223372036854775806; other operands signed negation
facts.count_nonpositive: OnTick skips NextMultiple and RecoverMp; UpdateMultiple remaining write is retained
facts.next_multiple: independent ready gate; if true writes wrap(R+FPmul(P,Int32ToFP(count))) before SP access; OnTick does not check returned bool
facts.recover_mp: unless force, independently read spStopped again; false reads SP once and requests setter wrap(SP+deltaFP)
facts.is_full: ordinary path independently reads SP then maxSp int32; direct signed FP GreaterThanOrEqual, no EPS
facts.rate: ordinary Entity.get_spRecoveryPerSec reads GetValue14 and GetValue30 then FPmul; canRecoverSp uses MathUtil.GT(rate,0), strict rate>EPS
facts.update_rate: valid prior timer -> OnTick(0), independently canRecoverSp, then ResetButKeepPastTime(ONE/newRate) or MarkInvalid; invalid timer -> Reset(ONE/newRate,true) without canRecoverSp getter
facts.rate_parameters: UpdateSpRecoveryPerSec(newValue:FP,oldValue:FP); ordinary implementation uses newValue but does not use oldValue
facts.reset_sp_timer: PeriodicTimer.Reset(true): remaining resets to current period; not MarkInvalid

supported_division_subdomain.context: OnTick precise batch count after ready; independent typedFP and all normal operation eligibility
supported_division_subdomain.numerator: A=source UnaryNegation(updated_remaining), including MIN64 special MaxValue
supported_division_subdomain.result: signed nearest half-up FP division over magnitude; extra quotient bit, plus1, shift1, then sign as original125 instructions
supported_division_subdomain.reason: absolute rational raw result<=FP.MaxValue keeps the extra-bit quotient plus1 within uint64 and out of per-shift saturation; no zero divisor
supported_division_subdomain.outside_bound: unknown until full overflow/saturation general-domain proof; do not call ONE-only reciprocal or Python float round
